scope: Percentages apply only to the documented Wikidata query inventories, not all natural features on Earth. Existing sampling points retain their original coordinate citations. River mouth coordinates cite Wikipedia revisions.

lake.universe_description: Natural lakes with recorded area >=100 km2 (reservoirs excluded); instance-of classes include subclasses. Earth coordinates and English label required. Area statements use km2, hectares or m2. This is a Wikidata inventory, not an exhaustive inventory of Earth.
lake.class_query: SELECT DISTINCT ?class WHERE { VALUES ?root { wd:Q23397 } ?class wdt:P279* ?root } ORDER BY ?class

volcano.universe_description: Volcanoes with a Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program number (P1886); instance-of classes include subclasses. Earth coordinates and English label required. Area statements use km2, hectares or m2. This is a Wikidata inventory, not an exhaustive inventory of Earth.
volcano.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { hint:Query hint:optimizer "None" . ?item wdt:P1886 ?gvp . ?item wdt:P625 ?coord; rdfs:label ?label . ?item p:P625/psv:P625/wikibase:geoGlobe wd:Q2 . FILTER(LANG(?label) = "en") } ORDER BY ?item
